common: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated ThornieDungeons fantasy mobile RPG inventory icon. Match the provided reference's polished painted game-art style: crisp dark contour, sculpted volume, strong selective highlights, saturated colors, clean readable silhouette at 48px, neither flat vector nor photo. Center entire object in square canvas with 12% safe margins, no clipping, transparent background. No text, letters, numbers, border, UI frame, stars or rarity badge. Reference images are style references only; generate only the requested object. Subject:

assets.name: bossHorn
assets.subject: One large curved boss horn, dark obsidian ridged keratin with ivory sharp tip, rugged broken base, subtle violet magical highlight. Clearly horn boss loot.

assets.name: bossHide
assets.subject: One thick irregular dragon boss hide pelt, reddish brown pebbled scales, torn thick pale leather edges and three small bony spikes, broad spread hide silhouette. Not folded cloth, not wood.
